result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back from every listing you named: active on a date, active in a region, by category, best for a category on a date, unused in a period, and lookup by code. The full offline suite passes (608 tests, including a new one in `PromotionTest`). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new six-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. The existing five-argument version delegates with a null description, so current callers are unchanged. A blank description is stored as null, and anything over 200 characters is rejected.
- **`DataStorePart09.java` / `DataStorePart10.java`**: the insert writes the description, and each of the seven promotion `SELECT`s reads it.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOfPromotion` test covering all the listings plus `findBestPromotion` and `findPromotionByCode`.

Two choices to confirm: the 200-character limit is my pick, and I made the description a plain text field with no other validation. The seeded demo promotions have no descriptions yet; I did not add any.
